svg.title: REFUSE VEHICLE: ROAD, HEADROOM, TURNING
svg.text: STANDARDS SHEET 08 · SITE · GOODS AND WASTE COLLECTION
Sysav 'Handbok för avfallshantering' (2025), section Framkomlighet och transportväg; vehicle dimensions are guidance for refuse trucks, not
loading-bay sizes. School programme example: 70 m2 delivery and waste yard (Uppsala 2019, school_compulsory).
road 3.5 / 5.5 m, headroom 4.7 m, turning Ø 18 m + 1.5 m — https://www.sysav.se/media/y2fnidqi/handbok-för-avfallshantering_2025_web.pdf
The plot must have suitable space for parking, loading and unloading 'i skälig utsträckning' on or near it (PBL 8 kap. 9 § första stycket 4), and this
applies 'i skälig utsträckning' also to an already built plot (8 kap. 10 §). Workplaces need a goods reception where needed (AFS 2023:12 3 kap. 32 §, as
cited in elderly_care_home; not re-read here). Waste must be removable 'på det sätt som krävs' (BFS 2024:8 11 kap. 3 §).
loading and unloading on the plot — https://www.riksdagen.se/sv/dokument-och-lagar/dokument/svensk-forfattningssamling/plan-och-bygglag-2010900_sfs-2010-900/
Marievik+ shell — TEMPLATE — NOT SURVEY DATA
Data: data/catalogue/uses/shared_amenities.json → spaces / shared_goods_loading (size.count). Drawn 2026-10-20 by docs/draw_standards_sheets.py. Diagrammatic, not to scale; figures and furniture
without a dimension are illustrative only. No values are taken from Neufert (catalogue policy: page references only).
